def nw(a,b):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-10**7
    H=[0]*(m+1); F=[NEG]*(m+1); TB=bytearray((n+1)*(m+1))
    for j in range(1,m+1): H[j]=-GOp-GE*(j-1); TB[j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=H[0]; H[0]=-GOp-GE*(i-1); TB[i*(m+1)]=1; E=NEG; base=i*(m+1); ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            up=H[j]
            e=H[j-1]-GOp; E=e if e>E-GE else E-GE
            f=up-GOp; F[j]=f if f>F[j]-GE else F[j]-GE
            d=diag+B62.get((ai,b[j-1]),-1)
            if d>=E and d>=F[j]: best=d; TB[base+j]=0
            elif F[j]>=E: best=F[j]; TB[base+j]=1
            else: best=E; TB[base+j]=2
            diag=up; H[j]=best
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        t=TB[i*(m+1)+j] if (i>0 and j>0) else (1 if j==0 else 2)
        if t==0: pr.append((i,j)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif t==1: pr.append((i,0)); i-=1
        else: pr.append((0,j)); j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
